name: Reality Glove (StretchSense) worn by N Kim, September 2026
comment: Measured, not guessed. UNRELIABLE right middle/ring/pinky: through sync_day1 and sync_day2 the right glove reports those three partly extended while the camera reads them clearly curled (pinky 1.55-1.68 against the camera's 0.78-0.90, take after take, in thumbs_up and peace) - a fault in that glove's fingers, not evidence about the camera, so they are kept out of the thumb gate's vote. The left glove does not do this and is left alone. RAIL OVERRIDE index only, on both hands: the index is the one finger a slow sweep has shown leaves its rail as soon as the camera sees flexion, so the rail reading is a saturation artefact the camera may overrule. The RIGHT RING is deliberately NOT enabled although it is the next suspect: its 2026-09-20 sweep (dead_zone_right_ring) started with the finger already bent, so the open reference is broken and the sweep has to be repeated with scripts/leap/finger_sweep.py before ring goes in here. Enabling it on an un-repeated sweep would let the camera take a curl on the strength of a measurement we know is spoiled. GLOVE LAG left 0.10 s, right 0.47 s: measured on this laptop's 2026-09-18/20 finger sweeps (cross-correlated curl traces), left about 100 ms, right 455 to 485 ms. A fallback, not an intrinsic glove constant: transport and software latency can change with machine load or XR Trainer version. Used only when the session's own clips cannot measure a lag (a session of held poses never can); a lag the session does measure, or one given with --glove-lag, wins, and --glove-lag none applies nothing. OVERRIDE MODE disagree (2026-09-25): a trusted camera that sees a finger at least 0.35 of its range more bent than the glove, for 10 consecutive frames, takes that finger's bend, on all four fingers of both hands; released below 0.20. Measured on the three recorded days: day 1 57/59 unchanged, day 2 53 -> 59/60, day 3 35/36 unchanged; right pinky residual .400 -> .138 on day 2; fires on 0.03 to 1.3 percent of open-palm and fist frames. Built after a live run on 2026-09-25 where the left glove drifted open mid-session while the camera, trusted and palm-facing, saw a fist; the rail-only override could not act because the glove was off its rail.
